context_for_next_testing_agent: Prescriptions module fully functional. Key endpoints: GET/POST/PUT /api/clinic/prescriptions, GET /api/clinic/prescriptions/:id/pdf-url, PUT /api/clinic/prescriptions/:id/send (MOCKED WhatsApp), GET /api/clinic/medications/search, POST /api/clinic/medications. PDF generated using reportlab and stored in Supabase Storage bucket 'patient-files' at path {clinic_id}/prescriptions/{prescription_id}.pdf. Frontend routes: /dashboard/recetas (list), /dashboard/recetas/nueva (new/edit form). Medication presentations are stored as array in medications table and populate dropdown when medication is selected.
